# Home espresso

Pulling shots on a lever machine in the kitchen.

## Dialling in

Start with 18 g of finely ground coffee and aim for 36 g in the cup in about 28 seconds. Grind finer when the shot runs fast and sour, coarser when it drips slowly and tastes bitter. Change one thing at a time.

## Milk

Steam whole milk to about 60 °C with the wand tip just under the surface so it draws in air for the first few seconds, then sink it to spin the jug. Tap and swirl until the foam is glossy.
